title: Los reales
goal: Change dollars and insist on small notes
culture: The money changers work the street outside the market with a calculator and a fold of notes, everybody uses them, and they beat the bank. Ask the rate first and ask for small notes: a thousand-córdoba note is no use to a pulpería or a bus.

beats.good: ¿A cómo está? asks today’s rate. It moves, everybody knows roughly what it should be, and asking says that you do too.

beats.es: A treinta y seis con cincuenta.
beats.en: I want to change a hundred dollars.
beats.good: Quiero cambiar is the entire transaction. He counts it into your hand and you are expected to watch him do it.

beats.es: Listo. ¿Se los doy en billetes de mil?
beats.good: A thousand-córdoba note is nearly useless: the pulpería cannot change it and neither can the bus. Ask for small ones every single time.
Cuéntelos is not a challenge. Counting it in front of him is normal, he expects it, and not counting is the odd thing to do.
